newsitem.title: USA: CME July, Aug pork bellies fall limit on weak cash.
newsitem.headline: CME July, Aug pork bellies fall limit on weak cash.

text.p: CME July and August pork belly futures fell the three-cent-per-lb limit in late trade, depressed by a weakening cash market, dealers said.
USDA reported at midday that cash bellies were trading at $92.00 per cwt, down $2.00 from Friday. The market had been on a strong upward trend, rising $10.00 last week.
August was offered the three cent limit down at 83.225 cents with other months 3.00 to 0.50 cent lower.
